titleEn: The data center demand is driving Microsoft's appetite for real estate.
titleZh: 数据中心需求推动微软对房地产的渴望

blocks.textEn:
When AI becomes the new oil, data centers are the refineries, and land has become the new mineral deposit that tech giants are racing to claim.

From a defunct Foxconn factory site in Wisconsin, to a quiet town on Finland's west coast, to the headquarters campus in Seattle, Microsoft is on a global "land grab" at breakneck speed—snapping up real estate properties worldwide. The tech giant is pivoting capital en masse from software code to steel and concrete—data center construction is rewriting the landscape of the global real estate market.

Microsoft's capital expenditure for the second quarter of fiscal year 2026 reached $37.5 billion, with roughly two-thirds allocated to short-term assets such as GPUs and CPUs. In the first half of the fiscal year alone, total capital expenditure hit $72.4 billion, and the full-year figure is on track to surpass the $100 billion mark. Behind this staggering number lies an unprecedented wave of global infrastructure buildout on a massive scale.
blocks.textZh:
当AI成为新石油，数据中心就是炼油厂，而土地则成了科技巨头争抢的新矿藏。

从威斯康星州废弃的富士康工厂旧址，到芬兰西海岸的宁静小镇，再到西雅图的总部园区，微软正以惊人的速度在全球“扫货”房地产。这家科技巨头正将资本从软件代码大规模转向钢筋水泥——数据中心建设正在改写全球房地产市场的版图。

微软在2026财年第二季度的资本支出达到375亿美元，其中约三分之二投向GPU和CPU等短期资产。仅上半年，其资本支出总额已达724亿美元，全年有望突破千亿美元大关。这一数字背后，是一场规模空前的全球基础设施建设浪潮。

blocks.textEn:
In Mount Pleasant, Wisconsin, Microsoft has taken over the "stranded investment site" left behind by Foxconn and is planning to build 15 large-scale data centers, with a total investment value exceeding $13 billion. This industrial site, once highly anticipated but left idle for years, has finally come to development. The project is expected to span approximately a decade, creating lasting job opportunities for the local community.

In Cheyenne, Wyoming, Microsoft is applying to expand two data center zones, covering 385 acres and approximately 35 acres respectively. Previously, the company had already announced plans to purchase about 3,200 acres of land in Cheyenne to develop a new data center campus.

Most strikingly, in Pecos County, West Texas, Microsoft is planning to build a data center campus spanning 7,000 acres, with an estimated capacity of 2,500 to 2,595 megawatts. This land—equivalent to nearly 4,000 standard football fields—will become one of the largest data center projects in tech history.

At its Seattle headquarters, Microsoft has completed the redevelopment of its East Campus, bringing the total number of buildings to 131. The campus has also relaxed building height restrictions, raising the limit from 6 stories to 10. Meanwhile, the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2)—founded by Microsoft co-founder Paul Allen—has brought in core research talent including former CEO Ali Farhadi, placing them within its frontier "superintelligence" division. This move not only strengthens Microsoft's in-house R&D capabilities but also cements Seattle's position as a premier AI talent hub.

Microsoft's Azure cloud business grew 39% in the quarter, with customer demand continuing to outpace available supply. Capacity constraints are expected to persist at least through the end of fiscal year 2026. CEO Satya Nadella stated bluntly during the earnings call: "We continue to lead the AI infrastructure wave and have gained market share in every quarter this year."

Microsoft currently operates over 400 data centers across 70 regions—more than any other cloud provider. In the past 12 months alone, the company has added over 20 gigawatts of capacity and continues to expand at a faster rate than any competitor.

Even more striking is Microsoft's construction of "AI superfactories"—using dedicated high-speed networks to connect data centers across different states into a distributed system that works in concert. A next-generation AI data center in Atlanta has already entered operation, linked via 120,000 miles of dedicated fiber-optic cable to the Wisconsin facility, integrating hundreds of thousands of the most advanced GPUs.

Data center demand is reshaping the fundamental logic of real estate investment. According to CBRE's 2025 Data Center Investor Survey, 95% of major investors said they would increase their data center investments, with 41% planning to commit over $500 million in equity.

Goldman Sachs projects that global data center electricity demand will grow 50% by 2027 and could surge 165% by 2030. Boston Consulting Group estimates that total data center investment demand from 2024 to 2030 will reach $1.8 trillion.

In the AI era, data centers are the new "land." Whoever controls the computing infrastructure holds the lifeline of the digital economy. This AI-driven real estate revolution is only just beginning—and how it will reshape the global economic landscape is well worth our continued attention.
blocks.textZh:
在美国威斯康星州蒙特普莱森，微软接手了富士康留下的“失落投资用地”，计划兴建15座大型数据中心，总投资价值超过130亿美元。这片曾被寄予厚望却闲置多年的工业用地，终于迎来实质发展。预计相关工程将持续约十年，为当地创造持久的就业机会。

在怀俄明州夏延，微软正申请扩建两个数据中心区域，分别占地385英亩和约35英亩。此前，该公司已宣布计划在夏延购买约3200英亩土地开发新的数据中心园区。

最令人瞩目的是得克萨斯州西部佩科斯县的计划——微软拟建设一座占地7000英亩的数据中心园区，预计容量达2500至2595兆瓦。这片相当于近4000个标准足球场的土地，将成为科技史上规模最大的数据中心项目之一。

在西雅图总部，微软完成对东园区（East Campus）的重建，总建筑达到131栋。园区还放宽了建筑限高，从6层提高至10层。同时，由微软联合创始人保罗·艾伦创立的艾伦人工智能研究院（Ai2） 引进了包括前CEO阿里·法哈迪在内的核心研究团队，并将他们纳入其前沿的“超级智能”部门。此举不仅强化了微软的自研实力，也巩固了西雅图作为AI人才高地的地位。

微软Azure云业务当季增长39%，客户需求持续超过可用供应，容量限制预计至少持续到2026财年末。CEO萨提亚·纳德拉在财报会上直言：“我们继续引领人工智能基础设施浪潮，并在今年每个季度都扩大了市场份额。”

微软目前在70个地区拥有400多个数据中心，数量超过其他任何云服务提供商。仅在过去12个月，该公司就新增了超过20千兆瓦的容量，并以快于任何竞争对手的速度继续扩容-7。

更令人震撼的是，微软正在构建“AI超级工厂”——通过专用高速网络，将跨越不同州的数据中心连接成一个协同工作的分布式系统。位于亚特兰大的新一代AI数据中心已投入运营，通过12万英里的专用光纤电缆与威斯康星州的设施相连，整合了数十万个最先进的GPU。

数据中心需求正在重塑房地产投资的底层逻辑。根据CBRE的2025年数据中心投资者调查，95%的主要投资者表示将加码数据中心投资，其中41%计划投入逾5亿美元股本。

高盛预测，全球数据中心电力需求至2027年预计增长50%，2030年更可能暴增165%。波士顿咨询集团估算，2024至2030年数据中心总投资需求将达1.8万亿美元。

在AI时代，数据中心就是新的“土地”，谁掌握了算力基础设施，谁就掌握了数字经济的命脉。这场由AI驱动的房地产革命才刚刚开始，它将如何重塑全球经济版图，值得我们持续关注。

titleEn: Seattle-Portland Twin-City Corridor | Value Undervalued Zone | Riverside Garden Villas in a Low-Density Community
titleZh: 西雅图・波特兰双城走廊价值洼地｜河畔花园别墅低密度社区

blocks.textEn:
With Seattle home prices remaining persistently high, a growing number of homebuyers are turning their attention to a prime node along the I-5 corridor—Centralia, Washington. Offering convenient commuting to both cities, standout price advantages, and sustained industrial growth, this undervalued gem is now home to a premium low-density villa community with front-row river views: Riverside Gardens.

Heart of the Twin-City Hub
A Rare Real Estate Value Opportunity

Centrally located at the very midpoint of the I-5 corridor, Centralia puts Seattle just 1.5 hours to the north and Portland 1.5 hours to the south—placing residents at the heart of a two-city lifestyle circle. Compared to Seattle's steep housing prices, local home values stand at just one-third of Seattle's, making the value proposition unmistakably clear.
blocks.textZh:
当西雅图房价居高不下，越来越多置业者把目光投向 I-5 走廊黄金节点 —— 华盛顿州 Centralia。双城通勤便利、价格优势突出、产业持续发力，这片尚未被充分挖掘的价值洼地，迎来一线河景低密度别墅社区：河畔花园 Riverside Gardens。

双城枢纽腹地

不可多得的房产价值洼地

Centralia 坐落于 I-5 走廊正中心，向北 1.5 小时直达西雅图，向南 1.5 小时连通波特兰，坐拥双城生活圈。对比西雅图高昂房价，本地房价仅为西雅图的 1/3，性价比优势一目了然。

blocks.textEn: Driven by a steady influx of tech professionals, military personnel, and retiring families, housing demand in the region continues to rise steadily. As a major transportation and logistics hub in Washington State, Centralia boasts a mature and well-developed transportation network—with BNSF Railway, I-5 Interstate Highway, and Amtrak intercity rail converging here, while major enterprises such as UNFI and Amazon distribution centers have established their presence. With over 30,000 local residents in the workforce providing sustained support, rental demand remains solid, laying a strong foundation for property value preservation and appreciation.
blocks.textZh: 伴随着科技从业者、军人、退休家庭持续迁入，区域住房需求稳步攀升。作为华州重要交通物流枢纽，Centralia 交通路网成熟完善：BNSF 铁路、I-5 洲际高速、Amtrak 城际铁路交汇，UNFI、亚马逊分拨中心等大型企业落地扎根。超 3 万本地就业人口持续托底，租赁需求稳固，为房产保值增值筑牢基础。

blocks.textEn:
Life in this small city is equally relaxed and livable: low crime rates, quality school districts, and abundant power resources also make it a prime candidate city for data centers. As the dividends of urban development continue to materialize, now is the time to secure your position in the last undervalued price zone along the Seattle–Portland corridor.

Riverfront Living
Exclusive First-Rate River Views

Riverside Gardens Villa Community is located in downtown Centralia, built along the banks of the Skookumchuck River. Between the residences and the riverway stretches an expansive lawn garden—this rare riverfront landscape resource grows increasingly precious amid ongoing urbanization.
blocks.textZh:
小城生活同样从容宜居：低犯罪率、优质学区、充沛电力资源，也是热门数据中心候选城市。城市发展红利持续兑现，此刻入场，占位西雅图 — 波特兰走廊最后的价格洼地。

滨河而居

私享一线河景风光

河畔花园别墅社区选址 Centralia 市中心，依 Skookumchuck River 河岸修建。住宅与河道之间，绵延开阔草坪花园，稀缺滨河景观资源，在城市化进程中愈发珍贵。

blocks.textEn:
Surrounded by large parks, complete with comprehensive commercial amenities, and located near Chehalis-Centralia Airport, Riverside Gardens offers the perfect balance of nature and convenience. No need for long-distance travel—a "micro-vacation" starts right at your doorstep. Whether strolling through the woods or relaxing by the river, for children who love the outdoors, exploring freely among the trees, rivers, and mountains offers a one-of-a-kind growth experience.

Seven Core Demand Drivers Provide Strong Support

Military Families | The "Golden Tenant Group" in the long-term rental market—steady yields as solid as a rock

University-Driven Demand | 4,800+ students and faculty—rental demand outstrips supply

Outlet Shopping District | Management + staff—a stable tenant base

Regional Silver Economy | Healthcare + senior care—generating rigid rental demand

I-5 Logistics Hub | Skilled blue-collar workers + management—premium rental choice

State Capital Spillover Effect | Preferred by government employees—top-tier tenant credit

Pillar Industry Support | High-wage blue-collar workers—solidifying the rental fundamentals

Project Core Information
blocks.textZh:
大型公园环绕，商业配套齐全，邻近 Chehalis-Centralia 机场，自然与便利兼得。不必长途远行，家门口就能开启 “微度假”。林间漫步、河畔休闲，对于喜爱自然的孩子而言，在草木山河间自由探索，收获独一无二的成长体验。

七大刚需强力托底

  • 军人家庭 | 长租市场“黄金客群”收益稳如磐石

  • 高校红利 | 4800+师生刚需，租房需求供不应求

  • 奥特莱斯商圈 | 管理层+员工，稳定租住群体

  • 区域银发经济 | 医疗+养老，催生刚性租住需求

  • I-5物流枢纽 | 高级蓝领+管理层，品质租住首选

  • 州府溢出效应 | 公务员优选，租客信用拉满

  • 支柱产业加持 | 高薪蓝领，夯实租赁基本面‍

项目核心信息

blocks.textEn:
• Project Name: Riverside Gardens

  • City: Centralia, Washington

  • Land Area: 16 acres

  • Single-Family / Duplex Villas: 49 units

  • Townhouses: 39 units

  • Delivery Timeline: Phased move-in starting from the end of 2026

  • Low-density planning ensures residential privacy and community comfort.

Backed by an Experienced Developer
Two Decades of Deep Roots in Washington State Real Estate

This project is developed and managed by New Home Real Estate Development Management Company. Established in 2016, the company's core team brings 20 years of large-scale real estate development and management experience in Washington State.
blocks.textZh:
• 项目名称：河畔花园 Riverside Gardens

  • 所在城市：华盛顿州 / Centralia市

  • 占地面积：16 英亩

  • 独栋 / 双单元别墅：49 户

  • 联排别墅：39 户

  • 交付时间：2026 年年底起分批入住

  • 低密度规划，保障居住私密性与社区舒适度

实力开发商护航

深耕华州地产二十载

本项目由新居地产开发管理公司打造。企业成立于 2016 年，核心团队拥有20 年华盛顿州大型地产开发管理经验。

blocks.textEn:
The developer's core members collectively hold over 5 million square feet of leased and developable real estate in Washington State, with a solid track record and numerous completed projects to their name. Major communities such as Mira Flat, The Emerald, Forum South Park, Florera, Evergreen Townhomes, and Belleview Park were all developed and managed by the team. With mature development experience and standardized project management, homebuyers can rest assured that their investment is in capable hands.

A Dual Opportunity: Homeownership & Investment

Ideal for Homeowners: Quality school districts, a safe and secure community, and a riverfront natural environment make this an excellent choice for families seeking long-term settlement, with convenient commuting to both Seattle and Portland.

Investment Advantages: Steady population inflows, a solid employment base, and strong rental demand; the region's value is on an upward trajectory with a lower entry barrier.
blocks.textZh:
开发商核心成员在华盛顿州持有租赁及待开发地产总面积超 500 万平方英尺，履历扎实，落地作品众多：Mira Flat、The Emerald、Forum South Park、Florera、Evergreen Townhomes、Belleview Park 等多个中大型社区均出自团队操盘。成熟开发经验、标准化工程管理，为业主置业保驾护航。

自住 & 投资双重机遇

自住优选：优质学区、治安良好、滨河自然环境，适合家庭长期定居，兼顾双城通勤


投资优势：人口持续流入、就业底盘稳固，租赁需求旺盛；区域价值处于上升通道，入手门槛更低

blocks.textEn: With home prices soaring in both Seattle and Portland, Centralia's Riverside Gardens villas offer an opportunity you won't want to miss—balancing quality of life with affordable homeownership.
blocks.textZh: 西雅图、波特兰房价高企，想要兼顾生活品质与置业成本，Centralia 河畔花园别墅，是不容错过的选择。

The Chinese Chamber of Commerce in Washington State (CCCWA), together with the Seattle Real Estate Investment Club, will host a focused briefing on FinCEN’s Residential Real Estate (RRE) reporting framework.
The session covers Mere Change in Form scenarios, practical compliance steps for Chinese families holding U.S. property, and how to balance disclosure requirements with privacy and long-term succession goals.
